event_hash.detail: All 40 EventHash values match SHA-256 of sorted-key JSON Header concatenated with sorted-key JSON Payload. This is not a full RFC 8785 canonicalization.

security_schema.detail: All 40 events include the v1.1 Security fields this verifier checks (Version, EventHash, HashAlgo, Signature, SignAlgo, MerkleRoot, MerkleIndex, AnchorReference). Field presence is not a signature or anchor confirmation.

audit_path.detail: All 40 stored audit paths reach the expected root, and each MerkleIndex matches the event's position in this file.

batch_bounds.detail: Published batch bounds match this file (EventCount=40, FirstSequence=1, LastSequence=40).

security_object_signature.detail: Security object signature verified as Ed25519 over the raw Merkle root bytes (raw_digest) with the trusted key. This authenticates the published root. It is not an external anchor.

external_anchor.detail: External anchor proof merkle_root.ots is not present, so the anchor was not confirmed. The anchor reference claims status ANCHORED via OpenTimestamps. That claim was not used as confirmation.
